jobs.name: esc1_descubrimiento
jobs.prompt: The strawberry in the floral dress walks in and freezes, seeing the banana holding a chocolate-covered spoon. Slow dramatic push-in on her shocked face. She says, trembling: '¿Otra vez con la cuchara?'. Pixar-style 3D animation, sunny kitchen, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, telenovela framing

jobs.name: esc2_excusa
jobs.prompt: The banana drops the spoon and raises both hands, sweating, forcing a charming smile at the camera. He says: 'Mi amor, puedo explicarlo'. Slow zoom on his guilty grin. Pixar-style 3D animation, sunny kitchen, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, telenovela framing

jobs.name: esc3_villano
jobs.prompt: The green lime in the purple cape steps out of the shadows, arms crossed, lit from below. He laughs and says: 'Yo se los presenté'. Dramatic slow dolly in on his crooked grin. Pixar-style 3D animation, sunny kitchen, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, telenovela framing

jobs.name: esc4_final
jobs.prompt: The strawberry turns away with dignity, one tear rolling down, and declares: 'Se acabó. Me quedo con la heladera'. She walks off frame. Slow motion, warm backlight. Pixar-style 3D animation, sunny kitchen, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, telenovela framing
